runs.note: NEAT from a cloned teacher network (24 hidden), six stages: calm, steady push, gusts, turbulence, boulder, polish. Training wheels fade in stages 2-4.

Attempt B = A with two fixes: the steady push now follows the wind ramp (in A it was always full strength), and training wheels start at 0.3, not 1.0 (the pilot landed 83% with full wheels, 84% without, 89.5% at 0.3). Steady-push pass lowered to 90%: a constant push up to 15 is harder than real gusts (the pilot: 84%).

Attempt C = B resumed from its population at gen ~412 (in the gusts + turbulence stage), with one change: the boulder stage ramps the boulder size from 40% to 100%. Why: the cloned start network only landed 25% with the boulder (pilot 77%) and B's best wind champion 14% (300 paired flights): the boulder skill was never cloned well, so it must be learned in NEAT, from small boulders up.

Attempt D: restart forced by a bug. Runs A-C started from a broken copy of the pilot: NEAT's tanh output squashed the cloned scores to ties, so 1 step in 9 took the wrong action (the copy landed 43% in wind instead of 92%). Fixed (identity outputs, test). Restarting, so three more changes ride along: the 15-input clone (+2 route sensors), seed noise 0.02 and weight mutation power 0.05 (the boulder skill is fragile: noise 0.05 cost ~10 points), and 30% boulder flights mixed into stages 1-4 so selection keeps protecting the boulder skill (forgotten twice before). The exact start network: 98% wind, 77% boulder (60 flights each).

Attempt E: the curriculum rebuilt around what the network can't do yet. Run D showed the easy stages destroy skill the exact copy already has (full wind: 90% at gen 0, 79% after calm air, 52% after the steady push; boulder 71% -> 38%), because selection only sees the easy world. So: start from the exact copy, train the weakness (the boulder) from calm air up to full wind, and fly 40% of every stage's training flights in the full final world (rehearsal) so nothing is forgotten.

Attempt F = E resumed at the start of stage 2 (gen ~152), with one change: 20 training flights per network instead of 10, and the top 8 re-flown on 60 instead of 40. Why: in the real task E's champions did not pass the pilot and drifted down (gen 75: 76.2%, gen 140: 70.0%, pilot 76.8%, 400 paired flights) while their stage-world checks rose: selection on 10 flights (4 of them real) is mostly luck.
